sources: Flare 2.0 新动作清单 2026-11-20（Google 表 1njBhCNMs-iliNbt3gKxDwCZnpQBxQoi-yPFRGQHmJwk，P2 脚垫高派克支撑）

purpose.zh: 练倒立方向的直臂顶肩，倒立前的入门版
purpose.en: Builds straight-arm overhead pushing in an inverted position; a stepping stone to the handstand.

text.zh: 手臂锁直往上顶肩，耳朵在两臂之间
text.en: Arms locked, push tall, ears between your arms

text.zh: 椅子靠墙放稳，前脚掌踩在椅面上。
text.en: Brace the chair against a wall; balls of your feet on the seat.

text.zh: 屁股顶高，身体成倒 V，髋角差不多 90 度。
text.en: Hips high in an inverted V, about a 90-degree hip angle.

commonErrors.zh: 耸肩缩脖子，没把地推开
commonErrors.en: Sinking into your shoulders instead of pushing the floor away.
Sagging your back and dropping your hips.

cautions.zh: 椅子要靠墙放稳；手腕或肩疼就停
cautions.en: Brace the chair against a wall; stop if your wrists or shoulders hurt.

flare2.plans: 1 个计划（阶段 11/15 初级，健身房/居家）
flare2.camera: 正侧面（与地面派克支撑同一机位）
flare2.doseBrief: 表内未给剂量；草稿按 3 组 × 20 秒、休 60 秒
flare2.note: Animation (r1): feet on a 45 cm chair, hip angle 94.5 deg, arms in line with the trunk (3 deg), hips 13 cm above everything else, shoulders push tall +26 mm, hold ~5.7 s.

set.zh: 手臂锁直往上顶肩，耳朵在两臂之间
set.en: Arms locked, push tall, ears between your arms
